protocol.scope: scenario-specific retrieval development and confirmation, not platform Formal Experiment

qasper.task: retrieval within the specified paper, not corpus-wide paper discovery
qasper.selection: sorted paper IDs then seeded shuffle; all questions for selected papers retained
qasper.primary: best annotator evidence-paragraph recall after context budget
qasper.neighbor_policy: at most previous and next paragraph within SAME section, budget constrained, no additional documents
qasper.matched_volume_control: heading_fill adds next BGE-ranked chunks within same8000byte cap; compare with neighbor expansion to distinguish extra context volume from structural selection. Same cap is not equal actual tokens; report actual bytes.
qasper.development_multiple_comparisons: Three fixed alternatives versus baseline, paired group CI98.333% for selection; final one frozen comparison CI95%.
qasper.eligibility: Keep all selected-paper questions. Primary evidence score only answerable questions with at least one nonempty and completely aligned annotation; report unanswerable/unaligned and all-source denominators separately; do not treat partial gold as complete.
qasper.annotation_normalization: Remove only explicit FLOAT SELECTED: UI prefix; require exact unique caption/text occurrence. Heading-only/unavailable/ambiguous evidence remains unresolved, with denominators disclosed. Captions are text-only and do not prove figure/table cell understanding.

musique.task: question-provided candidate paragraphs, not open full-corpus retrieval
musique.selection: seeded deterministic sample, complete distractors retained

protocol.comparison_policy: Dataset-specific settings. Finite mechanism profiles before confirmation; development may revise with explicit new protocol receipts. Once method selected, no confirmation-based reselection. No score until full planned split/capture complete; failed/unanswerable/unaligned cases retained with explicit denominators.
protocol.execution: Reuse production model adapters; initial exact dot-product candidate retrieval within benchmark-scoped paper/case. Does not claim production tenant/snapshot path until real integration tested.
protocol.safety: Original support flags, evidence labels, answers and question decomposition never enter retrieval input or model evidence. Existing snapshots, model allowlists, budgets, vision and fallback gates retained.

scope.scope: retrieval within the specified paper, not corpus-wide paper discovery
scope.timing: shared cached profile inference; not paired E2E

cost_note: same maximum context budget, not equal actual input bytes; shared cached profile inference, no paired E2E latency claim

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
